notes.title: 11/27 (Fri) Update Details (Modify)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38235056/4ed8d539d9cdcd5d392cae89fe2af8e778507e62.jpg

Hello Rebirthers,

We want to share some details about the November 27th  Friday's Update.

1. New Contents and Improvements

■ Prestige Edition Update

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38235056/8f4b96174dcafbedcdb62c55ae09fe3592ecc4cc.png

The Prestige Edition are still in progress, but it can be previewed at Smithy.

1) SR+ Grade Prestige Edition equipment set has been added
- You can craft it by using required material at:
Smithy> Craft> Edition.

2) New Craft Material has been added.
- The materials required for the Prestige Edition, can be crafted at Smithy> Craft> Materials.

The official release of the Prestige Edition will be updated later, and we will inform you through an additional notice.

■ Smithy Improvements
Improvements were applied in order to make it easier to filter the items according to the type when making Equipment and Collections.

■ Balancing adjustment
- PvP and PK: Damage has been slightly increased. (Equally applied to all the classes)
- PvP and PK: Blood on Hit will be applied under a certain chance when attacking (Equally applied to all the classes)

■ Bug Fixes and Improvements
- (Improvement) When doing Auto-Quests, the character stops when attcked by monsters. 
The character now will continue with the quest even when taken hit (But if there are lot's of damage taken, the character might counter-attack).
- (Improvement) The Refuge of Chaos has been changed, making the Battle starts immediately.
- (Bug) A bug that cause the characters to stop during Dungeons or Quests, have been fixed.
- (Bug) A bug that cause some monsters to not be found has been fixed. It was preventing the party from completing some Scenario Dungeons.
- (Bug) Fixed the problem of standing still in front of the Boss in the Scenario Dungeon.

2. Goods
Pre-update of Prestige Edition allows you to purchase related products in advance.

■  New product
- Prestige Edition Weapon production pack has been added.
- Prestige Edition Armor production pack has been added.
- Prestige Edition Accessory production pack has been added.
- Prestige Edition Material summoning pack has been added
* Details of the new products will be announced later in a separate notice.

■ Reset the number of purchases
- The purchase number of Raje's Enhance Pack is reset.
- The purchase number of Special Raje's Enhance Pack is reset

■ End of Sale
The Black Edition Craft II will be removed from the Shop


3. Google Play & Steam in-app purchases
Google and Steam pricing policy, all the in-app purchases will be integrated into the same price range in all the regions. This unification starts on Friday, November 27th.
- Platform : Google Play, Steam



Thank you.

Our sincere apologies,
